$comment: Cover sheet for an IMPORTED project, plus the inventory it cannot supply for itself. A first-party catalog declares its components with @CatalogComponent / @CatalogVariant beside the @Preview functions and omits `groups` entirely; a project imported without its maintainers' involvement has no such annotations, so the inventory is written down HERE. That is the one thing an import costs, and it is the honest place for it: this is our description of somebody else's code, and it stays in our repository. Home Assistant Companion phone/tablet catalog rendered from the fullDebug variant of :app. Full destinations use device-sized previews; state-hoisted settings bodies and dialogs remain wrap-content component previews. Synthetic Hilt Activity entries are intentionally excluded. The onboarding, quick-settings-tile, app-shortcut, Android Auto favorite and widget entries were dropped when upstream rewrote or removed those screens; re-add them once previews exist again.
